market.title: LeBron James' Next Team
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever team LeBron officially signs with (or, if he stays put or retires, resolves to the Lakers).
One real gap between the platforms: Kalshi's per-team markets stop trading and resolve based on a signing 'before Oct 23, 2026,' while Polymarket's cutoff is Oct 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.
If LeBron signs in that Oct 24-31 window, the two platforms could show different outcomes for a few days - worth knowing if you're comparing them closely in that stretch.

text: LeBron James signed with the Philadelphia 76ers on July 24, 2026: a two-year, $8 million deal. Neither platform had priced Philadelphia as a real contender for most of this market's run.

The genuine race, as tracked here, was Miami vs. Cleveland: Cleveland led as high as 55-61% through early July, then Miami surged past it on July 18-19 and held a narrow edge right up to the announcement.

Philadelphia never showed up as a serious price on either platform. Worth being upfront about that: the odds tracked the Heat/Cavaliers back-and-forth accurately, but the winner came from outside the two names everyone was watching.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
